scope: Bounded independent verification of selected high-value claims from the existing 30-transcript corpus.
policy: Official documentation verifies runtime capability or semantics only. It does not validate creator-reported TPS, VRAM, TTFT, speedup, or OOM results without matching model, artifact, runtime version, hardware, context, batch, workload, and measurement method.
